title: SpatialEpiBench: Benchmarking Spatial Information and Epidemic Priors in Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2605.06530v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate epidemic forecasting is crucial for public health response, resource allocation, and outbreak intervention, but remains difficult with sparse, noisy, and highly non-stationary data. Because epidemics unfold across interacting regions, spatiotemporal methods are natural candidates for improving forecasts. Despite growing interest in spatial information, no standardized benchmark exists, and current evaluations often use simple chronological train-test splits that do not reflect real-time forecasting practice. We address this gap with SpatialEpiBench, a challenging benchmark for spatiotemporal epidemic forecasting in realistic public-health settings. SpatialEpiBench includes 11 epidemic datasets with standardized rolling evaluations and outbreak-specific metrics. We evaluate adjacency-informed forecasting models with widely used epidemic priors that adapt general models to epidemiology, but find that most methods underperform

translated_title: SpatialEpiBench：评估空间信息与流行病学先验在预测中作用的基准
translated_abstract: 准确的流行病预测对公共卫生响应、资源分配和疫情干预至关重要，但由于数据稀疏、噪声大且高度非平稳，预测工作仍然十分困难。由于流行病在相互作用的区域之间展开，时空方法是改进预测的天然选择。尽管人们对空间信息的兴趣日益增长，但目前尚不存在标准化的基准，且现有评估通常采用简单的按时间顺序划分训练集与测试集的方式，无法反映实时预测的实际做法。我们通过 SpatialEpiBench 来填补这一空白，这是一个面向真实公共卫生场景的高难度时空流行病预测基准。SpatialEpiBench 包含 11 个流行病数据集，并采用标准化的滚动评估方式以及针对疫情爆发的专用指标。我们评估了结合广泛使用的流行病学先验（即将通用模型适配到流行病学领域）的邻接信息感知预测模型，但发现大多数方法的表现不佳。
tldr: 该论文提出了 SpatialEpiBench，一个包含 11 个流行病数据集、采用标准化滚动评估和疫情专用指标的时空流行病预测基准，评估发现结合空间信息和流行病学先验的大多数预测方法在真实场景下表现欠佳。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SpatialEpiBench, a challenging benchmark with 11 epidemic datasets, standardized rolling evaluations, and outbreak-specific metrics, showing that most spatially-informed forecasting models with epidemic priors underperform in realistic public-health settings.
